name: safeguard
description: Automatic English input translation and local after-send JSONL auditing with native Claude networking.

translate_output.title: Translate assistant display to Chinese
translate_output.description: After a turn finishes, send displayed assistant prose to the translation provider and replace only terminal rendering. Stored messages and model context stay original. Code literals stay unchanged.

api_base.title: Translation API URL
api_base.description: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions base URL for input translation and optional assistant display translation.

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Model used for input and optional assistant display translation.

api_key.title: Translation API key
api_key.description: Your translation service key. Missing configuration blocks submitted prompts.

api_key_file.title: API key file (optional)
api_key_file.description: Alternative for hosts without a secure credential store: absolute path to a private UTF-8 file containing only the key. Used when API key is unset.

audit.title: Audit recorded context
audit.description: Inspect local JSONL AFTER sending; cannot block a request already sent.

rules_file.title: Additional rules JSON
rules_file.description: Optional local rules file. Prompt rules block; context rules warn after send.

max_output_tokens.title: Translation max output tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Generation limit for input and display translation, from 256 to 131072. Default 32768. Truncated results keep the original or block input.

disable_thinking.title: Disable DeepSeek thinking
disable_thinking.description: Send thinking=disabled and reasoning_effort=none for DeepSeek models to reduce translation latency.
